INDICATION (as provided by referring clinician): Follow-up oligodendroglioma
ADDITIONAL HISTORY: Left temporal oligodendroglioma grade 2; Molecular: 1p/19q co-deletion, IDH1 R132H mutation; MGMT methylated.
Treatment History:
1. 3/18/2021: Initial diagnosis following seizure presentation.
2. 5/22/2022: Partial resection performed by Dr. Carter.
3. 8/15/2022: Initiated adjuvant chemotherapy.
COMPARISON: MR brain 1/15/2023
TECHNIQUE: Multiple sequences through the brain were acquired at 3 Tesla.
MEDICATIONS:
Gadovist - 16.9 mL - Intravenous
FINDINGS:
Compared to 1/15/2023, stable postoperative changes are noted in the left temporal lobe where partial resection was performed. No evidence of residual or recurrent tumor. Mild FLAIR hyperintensity adjacent to the resection site is consistent with postsurgical gliosis. Expected enhancement around the surgical cavity and pachymeningeal thickening. No abnormal diffusion or new masses detected.
Ventricular size remains normal, no hydrocephalus or midline shift. No acute infarcts or hemorrhagic events.
Remaining brain structures are unremarkable.

IMPRESSION:
1. Stable postoperative changes in the left temporal region with no residual oligodendroglioma.
2. Expected postsurgical gliosis and enhancement pattern.
3. No new findings; this MRI serves as a follow-up baseline.

Brain parenchyma outside the insular region appears normal.

IMPRESSION:
1. Stable appearance of left insular oligodendroglioma post-radiosurgery.
2. No new masses or significant changes noted since last imaging.
3. Continued surveillance recommended.
